title: Neighbourhood Centres Selected for Revitalisation of Shops Scheme and Possibility to Increase Funding Given Rise in Costs
what_it_is: Neighbourhood Centres Selected for Revitalisation of Shops Scheme and Possibility to Increase Funding Given Rise in Costs

sections.label: HDB ROS upgrading co-payment
sections.summary: HDB informed Town Councils and merchants' associations of selected sites, raised its co-payment share to 85%, and has no plans to change the ROS budget.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development):
sentences.text: HDB has informed the relevant Town Councils and merchants' associations of the selected sites in March this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development):
sentences.text: In 2023, we had increased the Housing and Development Board's (HDB's) co-payment share for the main ROS upgrading cost from 70% to 85% to reduce the co-payment borne by shop owners from 20% to 5%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development):
sentences.text: We also introduced additional funding support for optional works at the shopfront.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development):
sentences.text: There are currently no plans to change the ROS budget.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for National Development):
sentences.text: We will, however, continue to monitor the situation and refine our schemes as needed.

sections.label: ROS arrears collection by HDB
sections.summary: The Housing and Development Act was amended in 2023 to empower HDB to collect unpaid upgrading amounts from shop owners as arrears.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: As for costs, I have mentioned that we will continue to monitor the situation and see if any review is required, although, for now, the plan is to keep to the budget.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: Also, in terms of the Member's question about what happens if the merchants do not pay, in 2023, we amended the Housing and Development Act because of some policy changes under ROS.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: One of the changes that we have made is to empower HDB to collect the arrears or to collect the amount for the upgrading from shop owners who did not pay and to treat it as a form of arrears.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: This is something that the merchant associations would welcome because, in the past, it was the merchant associations who had to collect from these shop owners.
